lines.en: I'm magenta from head to foot, and I walk straight.

lines.zh: 我迈步，泥屑从我身上掉。
lines.en: I step, and crumbs of clay fall from me.

lines.zh: 我从队伍的一头走到另一头。
lines.en: I walk from one end of the line to the other.
My steps land evenly.
I walk along the fence.
Shallow pits mark where I've stepped.
I follow the one ahead of me.
I round the corner and keep going.
I don't look left or right as I go.
I lift each foot the same height.
I walk a square path.
I pass you without stopping.
I stand at the gate without moving.

lines.zh: 我的品红色在阴影里发暗。
lines.en: My magenta darkens in the shade.
I plant my sword in the ground.
I'm waiting for someone to relieve me.

lines.zh: 我身上有一道干裂的缝。
lines.en: A dry crack runs across me.
I don't look about.
An insect crawls over my foot.
I turn my head slowly.

lines.zh: 我脚下的土被我压实了。
lines.en: I've packed the soil under my feet.
You're standing in my posting.
I've counted your steps.
There's no clay on you.
The point hangs, aimed at the ground.
If you've something to say, say it.
I know this colour of mine.
Your hand is at your waist.
My whole row is watching.
You're already over the line.

lines.zh: 我在数你离墙还有几步。
lines.en: I'm counting your steps to the wall.
A piece is missing from my shoulder.

lines.zh: 这一下把我胸口开了一道。
lines.en: That opens a seam across my chest.

lines.zh: 我肩上的黏土掉了一块。
lines.en: A chunk of clay falls from my shoulder.
The sword nearly flew from my hand.
New dents appear on me.
I stare at the crack in me.
I straighten up slowly.
I don't make a sound.
Ash has mixed into my colour.
That bottle in your hand — that's acceptable.
I need nothing else.
If you're dyeing me, be quick.
I'll stand still like this.
I've no use for what you're holding up.
I answer only to my owner.
You'd better put it down.
I look once and that's all.
You'd best ask first.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，泥掉了一点。
lines.en: You hit me and a little clay falls.
I slide half a step and square up.
We collide with a clayey thud.

lines.zh: 这一下把我的肩膀撞凹了。
lines.en: That dents my shoulder.
I pick up the fallen clay.
We both wobble.
We kick up dirt.
I step back into my posting.
The paint on my helmet is scuffed off.
I level the blade again.
She stands opposite me.
Her magenta is deeper than mine.
We lay our swords crossed.
She tips her head my way.
We've nothing else to say.
Her cracks line up with mine.
We turn the same way.
At night we watch two gates.

lines.zh: 这一片由我们两个看着。
lines.en: The two of us watch this ground.
Day breaks, and we're still here.
I bend, and the clay creaks.
I cup it in both hands.

lines.zh: 我的手指在上面留了印。
lines.en: My fingers leave marks on it.
It slips between my fingers.
I hand it to my owner.
I shouldn't have taken this.
I bend down and pick it up.
It's heavier than I thought.

lines.zh: 我一手拿剑，只能腾出一只。
lines.en: One hand holds the sword; I have only one free.
I put it at the foot of the wall.
I've judged you an enemy.
My blade is already out.
The whole row moves at once.
I advance step by step.
None of us shouts.
I won't strike first.
You're hemmed in the yard.
This ground is ours.
The edge points at your chest.
I've started walking.
I bring the sword up to my shoulder.
This strike won't miss.
The one to my right closes too.
You're in the yard's middle, surrounded.
My blade stays pointed at you.
I'm standing quite steady.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我们就收一圈。
lines.en: A step back from you tightens our ring.
We close into a circle.

lines.zh: 你的影子被我的脚压着。
lines.en: Your shadow is under my feet.
You've reached behind your waist.
I know what you're reaching for.
I drop the point another inch.

lines.zh: 我身后的人已经绕过去了。
lines.en: The ones behind me have gone around.
You've nowhere to retreat.
I've measured this distance.

lines.zh: 品红的黏土手，抬起来了。
lines.en: The magenta clay hand lifts.
I cut at your shoulder.
A white scratch stays on your armor.
I strike twice.
You block; I draw the blade back.
My comrade and I press in.
That lands behind your knee.
I'm shoved back three paces.
I glance at my edge.
I charge in once more.
My wrist splits.
That one got you.
You retreat; we follow.
I used all my strength on that swing.
Clay falls off me and I don't stop.
You're down; we close in.
I let the sword hang.
A splash of magenta clay lands.
Hands first, then legs.
I look up for my rank.
I test the sword's weight.
I take the last place in line.
I square my shoulders.

lines.zh: 旁边的人和我一模一样。
lines.en: The one beside me is exactly like me.
I can't open a mouth, and I don't.
I wait for the order to come.
I was shaped out of clay.
The wind hardens my surface.
Fire curls my edges.
A leg snaps off when I land.
Water soaks half of me down.
The blast takes my shoulder off.
Something sharp sticks in my neck.
The light loosens my clay.
I don't eat; long sun will crack me.
Lightning falls and I split down the middle.
Empty below; I keep falling.
